clauses.title: SLAB URINALS
clauses.text: 1 SLAB URINALS (Second Revision) For detailed information, refer to IS : 771 (Part3/ Sec 1) : 1979 Specification for glazed fire-clay sanitary appliances, Part 3  Specific requirements of urinals, Section 1 Slab urinals (second revision). 1. Scope - Lays down the patterns, sizes, construction, dimensions and tolerances and finish of slab urinals made of fire-clay.

clauses.title: General requirements for materials, manufacture,
clauses.text: 2.1 General requirements for materials, manufacture, methods of test and inspection, shall conform to Part 1 (General requirements) of the standard.

clauses.title: Patterns and Sizes
clauses.text: 2.2 Patterns and Sizes — Slab urinals shall be of one of the following pattern and sizes: a)  Batter slab (see Fig. 1A of the standard) 1000 ×  600 mm or 1000 × 450 mm b)  End slab (see Fig 1B of the standard) 1000 × 360 mm

clauses.title: Construction
clauses.text: 3.  Construction —  Slab urinals shall be manufactured either as a single urinal or as a range of two urinals .  The inside surface of the urinals shall be regular and smooth throughout to ensure efficient flushing.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4. Tolerances a) On dimensions of 50 mm and over ± 4 % b) On dimensions less than 50 mm ± 2 mm. Note — For dimensions, see Table 1 nd Fig. 1 of the Standard.
